title: phlox gladiformis f. gooddingii
intro: Phlox gladiformis f. gooddingii, commonly known as Goodding's phlox, is a flowering plant species in the phlox genus, native to the southwestern United States. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving anxiety, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions as a sedative and anti-anxiolytic agent. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the plant's efficacy and safety for human consumption.
